Long, charcoal grey hair tied in a low ponytail with a center part. Narrow, slate grey eyes with a scholarly expression. Appears as a mature adult in his late thirties. Slender, lanky build. Wears a voluminous, high-collared deep purple robe with gold trim and a matching wide-brimmed hat. Carries a wooden staff topped with a blue gem.
BODY COLOR: pale skin
